description.value: Co'm Vietnamese is a Richmond restaurant that blends family-style Vietnamese cuisine with modern preparations, offering an extensive menu spanning pho, banh mi, fresh rolls, congee, and chef's specials. The restaurant features a dedicated vegetarian section alongside cocktails and traditional Vietnamese dishes. Located in a commercial plaza on Alderbridge Way, it offers a substantial sit-down dining option for cyclists exploring the Richmond area.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is fully available and confirms the address (7688 Alderbridge Way #120, Richmond, BC V6X 2A2) matching OSM tags; the contact subpage provides a phone number (604) 285-2654 not present in OSM. The menu page lists a dedicated 'Vegetarian' section, and prominent 'ORDER NOW' calls-to-action throughout the site confirm takeout is available. No explicit mention of bike racks, water refill, washrooms, or Wi-Fi was found in the website content.
